If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the [New Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AhmedabadWinterOpen2026#80577-new-competitor-information) tab before registering. 2. All competitors should be familiar with the information in all the tabs. Check out all the Tabs for more detailed information. 3. All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except newcomers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event. 4. Make sure you are available at the venue at least 20 minutes prior to your respective event's start time. You won't be allowed to participate in an event if you reach late. 5. No exceptions will be made unless discussed with the WCA Delegates in advance (contact us via the "Contact" section on the main page) 6. The final decision and rights to accept/deny the exeception request remains with the WCA Delegates. 7. If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your goverment ID card for verification.
